item.title: Bash
item.description:
Install Meshery CLI with Bash

To install or upgrade mesheryctl with Bash, run one of the following commands.

Option 1: Only install mesheryctl binary 

 

 

 $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | DEPLOY_MESHERY=false bash -


Option 2: Install mesheryctl binary and deploy Meshery on Docker 

 

 

 $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=docker bash -


Option 3: Install mesheryctl binary and deploy Meshery on Kubernetes 

 

 

 $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -


Option 4: Install mesheryctl binary and Meshery adapter(s)

Install the mesheryctl binary and deploy Meshery together with one or more adapters. Separate multiple adapters with spaces, for example ADAPTERS="istio linkerd". mesheryctl can deploy the consul, istio, linkerd, nsm, kuma, traefik, and cilium adapters. The script also accepts osm, nighthawk, nginx, tanzu, and app, but mesheryctl has no deployment definition for those adapters, so mesheryctl system start rejects them. The script ignores any other value.

item.title: Brew
item.description:
Install Meshery CLI with Homebrew

Prerequisites

You need Homebrew installed on your Linux or macOS system.

Install mesheryctl using Brew

To install mesheryctl with Homebrew, run:


 

 $ brew install mesheryctl

You’re ready to run Meshery. To start it on Kubernetes, run:




 $ mesheryctl system start

To run Meshery on Docker instead, run:




 $ mesheryctl system start -p docker
